question: Should OpenClaw continue supporting the released `skills/skill-creator/scripts/init_skill.py --resources` helper, or retire this issue and the linked PR now that current main routes durable skill creation through `skill_workshop`?
rationale: Automation can verify the latest release is affected and the open PR fixes that old helper, but current main removed the helper and repository direction now discourages live skill scaffolding through helper scripts.

options.title: Close obsolete helper surface
options.body: Close the linked PR and this issue together, documenting that current main no longer supports `init_skill.py` and `skill_workshop` is the supported durable skill-creation path.

options.title: Sponsor release/helper repair
options.body: Refresh or backport the parser fix intentionally, add focused tests for mixed-case resources, and document why the helper remains a supported shipped surface.

recommendation.title: Close obsolete helper surface
recommendation.body: Close the linked PR and this issue together, documenting that current main no longer supports `init_skill.py` and `skill_workshop` is the supported durable skill-creation path.

likelyOwner.reason: The original bundled skill-creator helper was introduced by Peter Steinberger, making him the strongest history-backed owner for the helper-retirement decision.
